Empirical trace variogram of axial data, for choosing the model

Source: R/interpolation_krige.R
variogram_axial.Rd

Bins the empirical variogram gamma(h) = mean(1 - cos(2 * (a_i - a_j))) over pairs of observations. Use it to choose nugget and range_km for stress2grid_kriging(), e.g. by overlaying the fitted model.

Usage

variogram_axial(x, breaks = seq(0, 500, 50))

Arguments

x

sf object with azi (degrees).

breaks

numeric. Distance bin edges in km.

Value

data.frame with lag (km), gamma and n (pairs per bin).
